opportunities.title: 64 BTC and 200 ETH just left for the mixers — the Coldcard story isn't over, it's laundering
opportunities.why_now: The hackers are actively cashing out right now, turning a disclosure story into a live forensics story.
opportunities.angle: Incident tracker: trace the mixer flows, note what this tells you about attacker sophistication and why 'wallet was secure' claims always age badly

opportunities.title: 15 different attackers found the same Coldcard bug — which means the real number who found it is unknowable
opportunities.why_now: Galaxy's count confirms this wasn't one clever hacker, it was a race, and races imply prior silent exploitation.
opportunities.angle: Security explainer: why 'independently discovered by N attackers' is the tell that a bug was live for months before anyone noticed

opportunities.title: $100M, three waves, one hardware wallet: the Coldcard timeline nobody wants to publish
opportunities.why_now: Galaxy has now confirmed the total damage crossed $100M across three distinct attack waves, giving enough data for a real postmortem.
opportunities.angle: Timeline breakdown: map wave 1/2/3 against disclosure and patch dates to show the gap attackers lived in

opportunities.title: Bitcoin core devs just flagged 85 critical bugs and called it 'extremely bad' — so why is BTC still $65K?
opportunities.why_now: A rare on-record admission of severity from core devs, dropped the same week as a $100M hardware wallet exploit — the market hasn't priced any of it in.
opportunities.angle: Markets-meets-security op-ed: the disconnect between protocol-level risk disclosures and price action, in the channel's signature 'already priced' framing

opportunities.title: Boltz just paused itself because AI agents are now running the attacks
opportunities.why_now: This is one of the first concrete instances of a crypto protocol halting service specifically due to AI-assisted intrusion attempts, a new threat category.
opportunities.angle: Trend piece: use Boltz as the case study to argue AI-assisted hacking isn't hypothetical anymore, tie to Claude Mythos AISI findings for a two-source thread
